bestBets.overview: The third meeting here since Thursday but of course we didn't get all the way through Sunday's card because of vision difficulties. That has led to the four races on Sunday being added to the ix today so we have an elongated 'mash-up' and we should be able to get all the way through today. I can't guarantee it won't still feel a little bleak and wintry out there though. We open with a distance Maiden and four of these - 3, 4, 9, 10 - were also in on Sunday in a different (arguably slightly tougher?) 2100m Maiden. In the end only THE DECEMBRIST ran in that, and given the fact he was beaten 23L we are unlikely to see him on a two day turnaround. EYE TRACKER may be able to find the front and that would take him a long way to a potential breakthrough. LE PLUS RAPIDE obviously went very close to winning last start but after 23 starts it's hard to be overly confident.

raceTips.comment: Ann-Jeanette Tindle has enjoyed great success on the Ballarat synthetic track, recording 6 wins from only 31 starters. Her horses seem to thrive on this surface and La Plus Rapide looks well placed to win if he can repeat his last start run when a brave second to Wolfoffitroystreet. The obvious knock is that he is a 23-start maiden, but his form has been more consistent of late and this is a very winnable race. Eye Tracker has upside and her pedigree suggests she should appreciate the rise in distance. Maps well from the inside draw and John Allen rides this track as good as any.

bestBets.overview: Back to just seven competing in this one. Pace from 8 and 9? IN'KANTOSSTAR was a market drifter on debut back at the tasil end of 2025 but it was a reasonable Maiden in which he finished runner-up and despite not having a recent public jumpout the full brother to Jimmysstar is priced here as though he will reach at least some of the heights of his famous G1 winning sibling. $1.35 was the raceday morning quote so dive in if you wish. I'll be watching and learning though. SWEET ALLURE made her debut on Heavy 10 now switches to synthetic. Will be settling top three from the rails draw. COLLECTIONNEUR was scratched on Sunday from a race in which a stablemate started $1.55 (but failed). Jumpouts have been OK.

raceTips.comment: No prizes for finding In'kantosstar as the most likely winner of this race. He has been heavily backed from $1.80 to $1.40 in early markets and is due to resume without any public trials or jump-outs. He is the younger brother of G1-sprinter Jimmysstar and arguably should have won on debut at Moe back in December. Ethan Brown is heading to Ballarat for just the one ride and he could end up a class above this field. Sweet Allure has a lot of natural speed and might be suited switching back to the synthetic after an okay debut on a real wet track at Warrnambool.

Lightly raced and happy on the wax, she sets up nicely here and they go for a claim for the first time.

raceTips.comment: Russian Duchess seemed underdone when she resumed over 1200m and still could have been vulnerable second-up at Cranbourne last start. Just Magic seemed to have every chance last start and just whacked away at the end of 1200m. The test will be whether she is strong enough to see out 1400m in this grade.

bestBets.overview: JUSTIBELLA proudly steps aside after breaking through on Sunday. DUPEROUZEL and LUVALOLA were beaten 5L and 17L respectively behind her so they would be doubtful you would think. UNOYASELF has shown clear improvement at start two and three and if he keeps the progress going I can see him finding a top three finish again after what will presumably be a nice trail in running. CRAFTY QUEEN has no early speed - she has been slow to step each start - so there's a real prospect of being buried away on the inside for a fair way of this race. If she peaks through a gap at the top of the straight expect her running on again. JULEP and JUST SWIFT others with winning claims. Newcomer AN POITIN STILL has been jumping out since mid 2025. Two recently have seen him settle well off the speed and not exactly take any ground.

raceTips.comment: Just Swift walked out of the barriers and did herself no favours last start. She has never been one to begin quickly but her settling position was costly when second to Flying Capital at this track and distance. If she can stay in touch with the field in the first half of the race, she is good enough to power over the top late. Quick Finish trialled okay prior to an average run on debut at Bendigo. The switch back to his home track and on to the synthetic could bring on improvement. Julep maps to be positioned near the lead and showed plenty of fight in a fast-run race at Swan Hill last start.

Tomanado has won three on the trot and seemed to love this surface when winning in easier grade two starts back.

Bonfire Jimmy is racing consistently and finds a winnable race third up. He likely settles on the leader's back from the inside barrier.
Razzo Rosso is an interesting runner on debut for the Mathrick stable. He may need the run however he's jumped out well and showed a lot of promise earlier in his career. 
Tomanado is airborne having won his last three starts including the latest dominantly and on this track two starts ago. This is tougher but no surprise to see him win again.

bestBets.overview: 7 to lead 2 and 1. AITU (winkers again) made an excellent return on the synth at Pakenham and he was shaping as an up-and-comer (of sorts) last spring. He was scratched on race morning though (Sunday that is) which leaves the toppie as the clear pick. PRINCEOFNOTTINGHAM (scratched from Caulfield Saturday) switches off Heavy and is a classic down in class/up in weight option. He made his return to this deck two back - after three years away - and showed he was very comfortable on the wax. PRINCESS SAKIKO held over from the earlier race to go here. She is some sort of threat but will have to run past PRINCE to be winning.

raceTips.comment:
Princeofnottingham is the class runner of the race. He has an excellent record at the track. He has plenty of weight but gets in pretty well after the 2kg claim considering his class and record at the track. 
Princess Sakiko looks ready to peak third up and is suited rising in distance. 
Real Alliance would probably win if she found something like her best form however her recent form makes it impossible to be confident.

Princeofnottingham is good enough to carry the big weight and win in this grade. He beat a stronger field carrying 61.5kg two starts back before struggling on a wet track at Sandown over 1800m last start. He loves this surface and is better suited back in distance. Princess Sakkiko has improved with each run this campaign and now should be ready to peak third-up. Real Alliance has been out of form and struggling on wet ground. The switch to the synthetic track could be what she is looking for.

bestBets.overview: Three chances in the last and they dominate this market. 4 and 2 head up front. ROYAL INFANTRY possibly settles behind the other three but how could you not like his return at this level. Blinkers are reapplied and 1200 to 1400 is perfect for a galloper whose two wins have been over the seven furlongs. No $26 available today. PACIFIC JEWEL comes from a different angle but his resuming effort up at Mildura was a pleasing outing. AKA DAKA ran 2nd to Bark on July 7, the same horse that defeated INFANTRY and JUST MAGIC 20 days later. With the back half of Sunday being tacked on here we actually get JUST MAGIC to give us a form reference earlier in the day.

raceTips.comment: Royal Infantry worked to the line nicely first-up over 1200m and now gets the blinkers on second-up at a more suitable distance. He maps to get a favourable run behind the leaders and looks hard to beat. Aka Daka should be fitter for three runs at 1200m this preparation and could be ridden more aggressive out to 1400m. Pacific Jewel ran well, albeit when finding the best part of the track, at Mildura first-up. That was only her second run for the Boyd-stable and may still have more improvement.

Aka Daka looks ready to win third up rising in distance with the in form Brad Rawiller in the saddle on the back of a day out at Mildura on Saturday. 
Royal Infantry hit the line strongly first up. He'll strip fitter and the rise in distance is a positive. He could've easily been my top pick. 
Pacific Jewel looks one of the likely leaders and will strip fitter second up following an encouraging effort first up.
